cryo-rack.png.name: Frozen cryo rack
cryo-rack.png.description: A cryoarithmetic engine's computing cabinet, rimed over and still leaking cold light.

frost-heatsink.png.name: Frosted heatsink bank
frost-heatsink.png.description: Upright heat-exchanger fins on a manifold, furred with hoar frost.

culture-vat.png.name: Culture vat
culture-vat.png.description: An armoured bio-culture vat under a clouded, cracked dome, something pale still in the fluid.

grow-bed.png.name: Overgrown grow bed
grow-bed.png.description: A hydroponic trough gone wild, pale stalks and fungus spilling over its rims.

frost-patch-a.png.name: Frost patch
frost-patch-a.png.description: Floor decal: a thin sheet of hoar frost and cracked ice. Walkable, no cover.

frost-patch-b.png.name: Frozen spill
frost-patch-b.png.description: Floor decal: a frozen coolant puddle crusted with rime. Walkable, no cover.

growth-patch-a.png.name: Biofilm patch
growth-patch-a.png.description: Floor decal: a mat of biofilm, lichen and creeping tendrils. Walkable, no cover.

growth-patch-b.png.name: Moss stain
growth-patch-b.png.description: Floor decal: an uneven stain of slime and moss with root threads. Walkable, no cover.

line-module.png.name: Assembly line module
line-module.png.description: A straight 6x3 section of a dead assembly line: roller bed flush to both short ends so sections join end to end (long axis east-west), a work station either side.

line-end.png.name: Line intake
line-end.png.description: The 3x3 end of an assembly line: a feed hopper housing, the line's bed leaving by its east edge with the module's cross-section.

empty-cradle.png.name: Empty product cradle
empty-cradle.png.description: A 3x3 floor cradle, clamps open, its product long pulled; the middle is open floor where a product stands.

rack-stripped.png.name: Stripped rack row
rack-stripped.png.description: A 6x2 pallet rack row, every bay empty.

rack-crates.png.name: Rack row, a few crates
rack-crates.png.description: The same 6x2 rack row with three crates left in it.

dock-door.png.name: Dock door
dock-door.png.description: A 4x2 loading dock: the armoured roll door along the north edge, set in the hall wall, and its leveler plate on the floor south of it.

cryo-unit-whole.png.name: Sealed cryo rack unit
cryo-unit-whole.png.description: A cryoarithmetic engine's computing rack unit, finished and sealed, the one the plant never shipped.

cryo-unit-half.png.description: A cryoarithmetic engine's computing rack unit, left half-built on the line: bare frame above, plating below.

cryo-unit-wrecked.png.description: A cryoarithmetic engine's computing rack unit, smashed and torn open, its pieces on the floor.
